### Structured Highlights for the Research Paper:  
**Title**: TETRIS: Optimal Draft Token Selection for Batch Speculative Decoding  
**Abstract**:  
We propose TETRIS, a novel method that optimizes the total throughput of batch speculative decoding in multi-request settings. Unlike existing methods that optimize for a single request or a group of requests as a whole, TETRIS actively selects the most promising draft tokens for every request in a batch to be accepted when verified in parallel. This results in fewer rejected tokens and more efficient resource utilization. The method is particularly important for service providers with limited inference capacity, as it improves the efficiency of large language model (LLM) inference. TETRIS outperforms baseline speculative decoding and existing methods that dynamically select draft tokens, leading to faster inference in LLMs.
